data:
go-approx is the home of approximation in the parity plan: interpolation, splines, polynomials, and later Chebyshev and AAA approximation and scattered data.
Package Status Repository interp released v0.1.0 go-approx/interp poly released v0.1.0 go-approx/poly
data.what-is-verified#What is verified: From STATUS.md: numpy.interp, interp1d, PCHIP, Akima and poly1d are bit-identical to NumPy and SciPy; splines agree within 1e-15 to 1e-10. The remaining interp gaps are in progress. The speed comparison with the Python reference is in interp’s docs/perf.md.
data.where-to-read-more#Where to read more: Landing: go-approx.github.io Documentation: go-approx.github.io/docs Organisation: github.com/go-approx

data:
go-bignum is the home of arbitrary precision in the parity plan: correctly rounded big.Float functions, number theory, and the Go oracle harness.
Package Status Repository bigfloat in development, not yet tagged go-bignum/bigfloat
data.state#State: From STATUS.md: the error model, the Ziv loop, roots, constants, and exp and log are done; trigonometric, hyperbolic and power functions are in progress. No release has been tagged.
data.where-to-read-more#Where to read more: Landing: go-bignum.github.io Documentation: go-bignum.github.io/docs Organisation: github.com/go-bignum

go-dsp is the home of signal processing in the parity plan: filter design and filtering, spectral estimation, and later resampling, wavelets and audio I/O.
Package Status Repository signal released v0.1.0 go-dsp/signal
data.where-to-read-more#Where to read more: Landing: go-dsp.github.io Documentation: go-dsp.github.io/docs Organisation: github.com/go-dsp Status of every item: STATUS.md

go-sparse is the home of sparse linear algebra in the parity plan: sparse containers, orderings, iterative solvers, and later direct solvers and sparse eigensolvers.
Package Status Repository sparse released v0.1.0 go-sparse/sparse
data.what-is-verified#What is verified: From STATUS.md: iteration counts equal SciPy’s for CG, GMRES, MINRES and LSQR.
data.where-to-read-more#Where to read more: Landing: go-sparse.github.io Documentation: go-sparse.github.io/docs Organisation: github.com/go-sparse
